name: C066 Linh Mục Khiên Đơn (Trượng Ấn Thuẫn Báo Trước)
prompt_ref:
Create a single-cell 1x1 reference sheet of a dark-fantasy Aegis Priest's shield-crest crosier staff (Trượng Ấn Thuẫn Báo Trước - C066 Linh Mục Khiên Đơn) following the exact square cell of the attached reference layout_guide_1x1.png.

COMPOSITION & ORIENTATION (100% MANDATORY):
- Draw ONE complete cleric crosier staff oriented DIAGONALLY from bottom-left (reinforced iron and white-gold shaft) to top-right (a crest shaped like an ornate kite-shield emblem with a glowing golden-amber barrier rune at its center).
- Must show 100% of the entire staff from bottom tip to top shield-emblem crest with generous padding inside the frame (occupying 65%-75% of the canvas).
- Zero clipping at canvas edges.

COLOR & BACKGROUND (100% MANDATORY):
- Background MUST be flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) edge-to-edge.
- DO NOT use any magenta/pink tones on the staff itself (use brushed steel, antique gold, ivory enamel, and warm amber-gold barrier runes).
- No character hands, no text, no borders.
prompt_card:
Create a wide horizontal 16:11 dark-fantasy card illustration featuring the exact same Shield-Crest Cleric Staff (Trượng Ấn Thuẫn Báo Trước - C066 Linh Mục Khiên Đơn) from the attached reference image.

COMPOSITION & BACKGROUND (100% MANDATORY):
- Place the shield-emblem crosier staff diagonally across the center of the horizontal frame.
- Full atmospheric dark-fantasy background (100% opaque RGB illustration, NO magenta, NO transparency): a stone bastion sanctuary where hexagonal golden-amber protective barrier shields project outward from the staff's crest.
- Do NOT draw any card frame, borders, or text.
